title: Alibi and Parish
author: Wendell Nakamura
blurb: Jude Dravenmoor, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
